name: Michal
bio: Michal was Saul's younger daughter, who later became David's wife. Scripture first names her while listing Saul's household, alongside her older sister Merab (1 Samuel 14:49). Her love for David, her role in helping him escape Saul's attempt to kill him, and the later story of the growing distance and bitterness between her and David, unfold in detail through the rest of 1 and 2 Samuel.
